name: Statistical Inference
description: Explore key concepts of statistical inference through concise, thought‑provoking questions.

questions.question: What is the primary goal of hypothesis testing?
options: To decide if data support a claim
questions.explain: Hypothesis testing evaluates evidence against a stated hypothesis.

questions.question: Which error occurs when we incorrectly reject a true null hypothesis?
questions.explain: Rejecting a true null hypothesis is a Type I error.

questions.question: What does a 95% confidence interval represent?
options: It contains the true parameter 95% of the time
There is a 95% chance the parameter lies in it
The interval will contain 95% of the data
The sample mean is within 95% of the population mean
questions.explain: A 95% confidence interval is constructed so that 95% of such intervals capture the true parameter.

questions.question: Which statistic is used to test equality of variances across groups?
questions.explain: The F-test compares variances to assess if they are equal.

questions.question: In linear regression, the coefficient represents...
options: The average change in Y for each unit change in X
The proportion of variance explained by the model
The typical distance of points from the line
questions.explain: The slope coefficient shows how Y responds to changes in X.

questions.question: What is the p-value in hypothesis testing?
options: Probability that the null hypothesis is true
Probability of making a Type I error
Probability of observing data as extreme as the sample
Probability that the alternative hypothesis is true
questions.explain: The p-value measures how unlikely the observed data are under the null.

questions.question: Which measure indicates the strength of association in a contingency table?
questions.explain: Cramer's V quantifies association between categorical variables.

questions.question: What does the Central Limit Theorem state?
options: Sample means approach a normal distribution as n grows
The population distribution is always normal
Variance decreases as sample size gets larger
questions.explain: The CLT explains why the sampling distribution of the mean becomes normal.

questions.question: Which test compares means of three or more groups?
questions.explain: ANOVA tests whether group means differ significantly.

questions.question: What is a Type II error?
options: Failing to reject a false null
questions.explain: A Type II error occurs when we do not reject a false null hypothesis.
